ios.desc:
Your Widgets lets you add beautiful, stylish and useful widgets to your home screen. With a variety of designs and styles in the Widget Library, you can either choose an existing style or personalize them to suit your home screen.

Set up widgets for your iOS homescreen within minutes.

WIDGET LIBRARY
Offers great variety of styles and designs in all supported widget sizes.

PERSONALIZE YOUR WIDGETS
Choose a beautiful design from the Widget Library to set them to your home screen. You also have an option to personalize widget design from the library with your photos, colors and fonts.

CALENDAR, CLOCK & INSPIRATIONAL QUOTES
Widgets feature time, date or calendars which you can personalize for your home screens. Selected widgets also feature inspirational quotes which change every minute. Now at every glance you get some wisdom!

When purchasing a subscription you agree to the Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy which can be viewed by going to: http://croozeus.com/yourwidgets/tos/ and http://croozeus.com/yourwidgets/privacy
